test_Repo_init: test the Repo class initialization that creates a wgit directory with sha1_store and git tracking
test_Repo_add: test the Repo add method that tracks PyTorch checkpoint files with optional per_tensor and gzip options
test_Repo_commit: test the Repo commit method that saves tracked changes with a commit message to the git log
test_Repo_status: test the Repo status method that returns CLEAN, CHANGES_ADDED_NOT_COMMITED, or CHANGES_NOT_ADDED for tracked files
test_Repo_log: test the Repo log method that prints the version history of a tracked checkpoint file
